People: James Baldwin (author, Wikidata Q15976232), died 1925. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Baldwin, James, 1841-1925") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Fifty famous people, a book of short stories, New York, Cincinnati [etc.] American book company, c1912, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/fiftyfamouspeopl00baldrich. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 95%, 83%, 89% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
